title: The War Brief: China COURTING Iran? Trump Threatens Tactical Nukes—and How Ansarallah STORMED Yemen
author: Murtaza Hussain
content:
In the first episode of War Brief, Murtaza Hussain and Sarmad Jawad dig into
the latest military updates from around the world, including China's positive
overtures to Iran, Donald Trump once again threatening Iran with tactical
nuclear weapons, Iran's successful attack on a U.S. military base in Jordan,
and more. We then deep dive into what went into making Ansarallah's drive to
capture western Yemen successful.  
  
The War Brief is a new show by Drop Site News that covers all things related
to major armed conflicts and wars around the world.

Subscribe on [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@DropSiteNews) and wherever you
get podcasts.
